A '''sarlacc''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chad/Legends|Chad]], and during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] released huge clouds of spores into the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the world.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Spore Clouds}}</ref>
